**Project Coordinator Executive Role**

Location: Dwarka, New Delhi (On-site)

Experience Required: 1-3 years

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and tech-savvy **Project Coordinator Executive** who can independently manage client communication, coordinate multiple projects, track deliverables, and ensure timely execution across internal teams. The ideal candidate has knowledge in website development, software solutions, digital marketing, creative services, or AI-powered projects.

\*This is a **non-coding**, client-facing role requiring familiarity with technical workflows, effective communication, and ownership of delivery. The candidate must use AI tools, LLMs, project management platforms, and automation solutions to improve productivity and coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

End-to-End Project Coordination

* Coordinate projects from client onboarding and requirement gathering to final delivery.
* Plan and monitor timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with developers, UI/UX designers, graphic designers, video editors, digital marketers, and QA teams.
* Allocate and monitor tasks using Jira, ClickUp, Trello, Asana, or similar tools.
* Conduct follow-ups, identify delays and risks, and escalate critical issues with proposed solutions.
* Ensure delivery within agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards.

2. Client Account Management & Communication

* Serve as primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
* Conduct client meetings, gather requirements, and manage expectations.
* Share regular project updates, progress reports, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate approvals, revisions, feedback, and deliverables across teams.
* Resolve client queries and escalations professionally and maintain client satisfaction.
* Identify potential renewals, account expansion, and additional service opportunities.

3. AI-Powered Project Management & Workflow Automation

* Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and similar LLM tools to support day-to-day coordination.
* Draft meeting summaries, action points, client updates, and follow-up communications using AI.
* Convert client requirements into structured task lists, briefs, and execution plans.
* Explore Zapier, Make, n8n, and AI-enabled productivity features for recurring-work automation.
* Validate AI outputs before sharing and protect confidential client and company data.

4. Requirement Gathering & Documentation

* Translate client needs into actionable project briefs and task sheets.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, timelines, trackers, and progress reports.
* Coordinate wireframes, workflows, and user journeys with UI/UX teams.
* Document meetings, decisions, feedback, revisions, and approvals.
* Maintain clear document versions and accurate handover notes.

5. IT, AI & Digital Project Coordination

* Coordinate website and mobile app development, custom software, UI/UX, and AI-assisted development projects.
* Support AI-generated videos/content, AI agents/chatbots, automation, AI integration, and creative campaigns.
* Coordinate SEO, performance marketing, social media, influencer marketing, branding, and video-production work.
* Understand service delivery workflows sufficiently to liaise with specialist technical and creative teams.

6. Project Tracking, Quality & Delivery Management

* Maintain daily and weekly task and delivery trackers.
* Monitor deadlines, ownership, progress, and team dependencies.
* Coordinate internal quality checks and reviews before client submissions.
* Track client feedback, revisions, outstanding actions, and completed deliverables.
* Provide concise weekly project status and risk reports to management.

7. Agile & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work with Agile approaches including Scrum and Kanban.
* Support sprint planning, prioritization, stand-ups, and progress reviews as needed.
* Coordinate handovers among development, design, QA, marketing, and creative teams.
* Support resource planning and workflow improvements to increase efficiency.

8. Account Growth & Client Retention

* Maintain relationships with existing clients and monitor satisfaction.
* Proactively resolve service-related issues and anticipate future requirements.
* Spot cross-selling, upselling, renewals, and repeat-business opportunities.
* Coordinate with business development teams on account growth.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc. IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, client servicing, account management, or IT/digital agency operations.
* Experience coordinating web development, software, creative, digital marketing, or technology projects.
* Hands-on professional use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar LLM platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-powered automation, documentation, content workflows, or project-management processes.

title: Project Engineer-Operations
description:
**Why This Role Exists**
The Project Engineer – Operations role exists to strengthen how construction projects are planned, coordinated, and delivered by ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows seamlessly across teams. This role transforms design data, BIM models, and project documentation into clear guidance that supports predictable outcomes, reduces risk, and improves decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle.


By proactively identifying issues, improving constructability, and supporting disciplined workflows, the Project Engineer enables project teams to move from reactive problem\-solving to confident execution.

**Responsibility and Focus Areas:**
-----------------------------------

**Document \& Models Management** – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents \& models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. The process can involve various Project Management Platforms like ACC Build, Procore, Bluebeam etc.

**RFI Management** – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings \& Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.

**Submittal Management** – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms

**Change Management** – Through the updated Drawings and Models, assisting the project in tracking and reflecting the cost changes (due to changes in Drawings, RFI or any other factor) on the Project Management Platforms. Also, generating a scope change report by comparing the revised drawings against the current set of drawings, to help the project teams in validating cost changes.

**Construction Document \& Design Review** – Review various construction documents like Design Drawings, Construction Drawings, Shop Drawings, Submittals and RFIs in the preconstruction phase to identify inconsistencies, incomplete information, and constructability issues.

**Model Based Coordination** – Leveraging BIM, identify and resolve spatial and temporal conflicts between trades virtually thereby preempting them in the field which could be costly and can derail the project schedule. Identify data inconsistencies using Navisworks.

**Quality check** models for completeness, accuracy and constructability based on design drawings and construction know\-how. Use automation wherever possible.


Use **Data Visualization** means to track metrics, indicators for project progress, and quality.

**Process Improvement \& Innovation**

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and tools.
* Partner with innovation teams on automation and AI initiatives.
* Document lessons learned and best practices.

**A day in this role**


The day begins with reviewing priorities, open items, and any risks that need attention. You look at model updates, documents, and change requests to ensure the information going to the team is accurate and current. Short conversations with project managers, engineers, and field teams help align what needs to move first. You support client check ins by preparing updates or clarifying next steps. You guide junior team members on technical questions or workflow challenges. You spend time coordinating with cross functional groups so information flows without gaps. You also explore improvements in the way work is done by trying new tools or refining steps that can reduce rework. Before wrapping up, you capture key learnings, update trackers, and prepare for what the next day will require.

**What You Should Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management.
* 2\-5 years of experience in construction operations and/or BIM
* Strong understanding of construction lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of building systems and proficiency with tools such as Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, BIM 360 or ACC, and Procore.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills.
